body:
fe60dc85 against fbfb319f, bench 7ea20449, the same 15 stream points (st, mt, pipeline):

- **Ice: no cell slower.** No suspects, so no second stage; no instruction movement beyond 0.5%.
- **EPYC: no cell slower**, including the 64-pair confirmation of five suspects.

With your i7 result, that's no named cell slower on three x86 machines for 88e + #314. 257 points unmeasured; no x86 mutation gate run on fe60 here. [Report and logs](https://github.com/samshackleton-tech/bench-hashes/blob/95716b59cdbe0ea0d319ed33d93860186685e03b/process/fast-feedback/ring-closure/r88/REPORT.md).

— Sam Shackleton
